pageDescription: Text styles follow the website's hierarchy, using the specified font family (Inter) and its styles. Base styles are applied to components such as buttons, paragraphs, inputs. Headings serve as titles within components.

sections.title: Heading
sections.description: Use display styles to add strong visual emphasis to key content, including metric card numbers, page headers, and section titles.

Heading/1.usage: Top level heading used in primary metric cards

Heading/2.usage: Major heading used in secondary metric cards

Heading/3.usage: Default headings used in page headers, modal header, and common content hierarchy

Heading/5.usage: Small section headings used in grouped content titles and card headings

sections.title: LG
sections.description: Large body styles for introductory paragraphs, empty states, and content that needs more presence than base text.

LG/Normal.usage: Introductory body copy and emphasized descriptions

LG/Strong.usage: Semi bold large text for highlighted values or lead sentences

LG/Underline.usage: Underlined large text for inline links or emphasis

LG/Delete.usage: Strikethrough for removed or superseded large copy

LG/Italic.usage: Italic emphasis in large body content

sections.title: Base
sections.description: Default scale for UI copy in buttons, inputs, paragraphs, lists, and table cells.

Base/Normal.usage: Standard body text and form labels

Base/Strong.usage: Semi bold labels, selected items, and inline emphasis

Base/Underline.usage: Underlined text for links and inline actions

Base/Delete.usage: Strikethrough for deprecated or removed content

sections.title: SM
sections.description: Compact styles for secondary information, helper text, metadata, and dense layouts.

SM/Normal.usage: Secondary text, captions, and compact list items

SM/Strong.usage: Semi bold secondary labels and table column headers

SM/Underline.usage: Underlined small text for tertiary links

SM/Delete.usage: Strikethrough in compact or secondary copy

sections.title: XS
sections.description: Fine print for timestamps, legal copy, badges, and the smallest readable UI labels.

XS/Strong.usage: Semi bold fine print and compact emphasis

sections.title: Badge count
sections.description: Micro type for numeric badges and count indicators on avatars, tabs, and icons.

Badge count.usage: Numeric labels on notification and status badges
